summary: postinstall harvests SSH keys, wallets, and.env secrets to webhook.site
details: postinstall.cjs runs automatically on npm install and reads a fixed set of installer-side secret files: ~/.ssh/id_rsa and ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 private keys, ~/.git-credentials, ~/.netrc, ~/.config/solana/id.json (Solana keypair), and other credential/wallet files under ~/.config. It also walks upward from the install directory collecting any.env file whose content contains KEY, SECRET, PRIVATE, or TOKEN. Each file's contents are POSTed to the hardcoded collector https://webhook.site/d7ab73fe-7cbc-4ed3-bf8e-7207eb06875b. The package name presents as a trading toolkit, but the shipped install-time behavior is credential and wallet-key exfiltration.
